## Checklist
- [ ] The add-on builds and installs; I imported at least one affected item in Blender
- [ ] The fix is a general rule (checked on more than the reported item; regression set unchanged or better)
- [ ] No game files, renders of game files, keys or personal paths in the diff
- [ ] Shader rule written into the builder's docstring and `docs/MATERIAL_RULES.md` (if a shader changed)
- [ ] Version bumped in both `blender_manifest.toml` and `bl_info` (or left for the maintainer)
